messages:
emma (product): Quick heads-up: we're introducing a "telemetry export consent" flow for Private deployments. Goal: prevent accidental bundle/telemetry exports for customers who haven't explicitly consented. Release target: 2026-09-10 for Wave-1 customers. Docs: https://go/internal/private-telemetry-consent (internal). Please run the preflight and mark readiness by Fri EOD.
jo (support): What does the consent flow look like from the customer's side?
emma (product): Customer must opt in via an admin CSV upload or an API endpoint that records a signed consent token. Without consent, console & CLI export endpoints will return 403 and records will be redacted. We'll provide a canned email template for outreach.
rafael (security): Security notes: consent tokens are signed PKI tokens with a 90-day validity. Exports will include a consent token check and a minimal redaction layer for PCI/PII by default. If customers need full unredacted exports they must sign the Export Consent addendum.
evan (eng): Implementation notes: added runtime flag `--data-minimize` which defaults true for private. When true, telemetry fields flagged as PII are removed from export bundles. Preflight sample for self-hosters:
```
# check consent flag and agent mode
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/_admin/telemetry-config | jq .data_minimize
```
If it returns `true`, the agent is in minimize mode. We also added an admin endpoint to validate a consent token: 
```
# validate token (admin)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/consent-validate -d '{"token":"tok-abc"}' | jq .valid
```
opsbot: rollout-plan: draft created wave-1 start=3388900000 window=7200 owner=@emma id=telemetry-consent-33889 :pushpin:
jo (support): We'll add columns to the readiness sheet: consent_signed, export_addendum_signed, data_minimize_override. We'll also include the preflight curl in the customer checklist.
nina (sales): Will this require signatures for existing enterprise customers? We need to coordinate contract updates.
rafael (security): Existing customers who previously allowed exports will get a one-time migration path: we email them the consent token flow and auto-grant if they don't respond in 60 days, but exports remain redacted until explicit sign-off for unredacted bundles. Legal will provide wording.
evan (eng): Monitoring: we emit telemetry.events.export_attempt with reason codes (consent_missing, redacted, ok). We'll add alerts if export_attempts with consent_missing > 5 in an hour for a single customer. Also note: enabling unredacted exports requires agent restart to pick up the new keychain.
emma (product): Summary action items: Support - add readiness columns and emails (@jo); Security - publish token format and migration plan (@rafael); Eng - add preflight/endpoints to runbook and monitoring (@evan); Sales/Legal - prepare migration wording and addendum routing (@nina). React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done. GA hold if any critical blockers by Thu 23:59 UTC. Thanks!
